correctness.rationale: Actual Kautz digraph has 12 admissible length-three words, 24 shifted arcs, indegree 2 at every vertex; exactly 3^12 incoming-edge assignments exhaust every face. Independent reconstruction enumerated 314,928 faces including the empty face and the 4,608 top and 132 next-to-top facets (24 root pairs, multiplicities 21 times five and three times nine). Independently recreated complete 157,439 nonempty face Morse pairs and checked a directed-Hasse topological sort of 314,927 nodes and 2,361,936 incidences, with critical dimensions (0:1,8:3,9:22,10:23). Recomputed the complete signed integral 3-by-22 and 22-by-23 Morse boundary matrices, their zero product, 3 and 11 integral unit cancellations, and zero residual boundary. The surviving 8 cells in degree 9 and 12 in degree 10 attach by null maps because π9(∨S9)=H9, establishing the integral wedge, not merely homology. The 384 spanning arborescences per root supply an independent determinant check. This establishes ONLY the specified finite digraph, not other Kautz parameters.
